question: How do I specify which example to pre-fill in the RunnableEndpoint component form?
ground_truth: You can pre-fill the form with a specific example by using the `example` property. Set it to the name of the example you want to use, like `<RunnableEndpoint endpoint="GET /api/users/{{id}}" example="example-name" />`. If not specified, the first example is used by default.

metadata.cited_context: Pre-fill the form with a specific example by name. If not specified, the first example is used by default.
